blocks.text: 117-darsdagi ro'yxat alifbo tartibida — undan shaklni qidirish qulay. Yodlash uchun esa **shakli o'xshash** fe'llarni birga o'rganish ancha oson: ular bir xil ohangda o'zgaradi, bittasini bilsangiz, qolganlari o'zi esda qoladi (sing – sang – sung → ring – rang – rung). Bu darsda o'sha fe'llar to'rt katta guruhga ajratilgan; har bir guruh ichida esa o'zgarish qolipi bo'yicha kichik guruhlar bor.

rows: eng katta guruh: V2 ni bilsangiz, V3 tayyor

blocks.text: 1-guruh: uchala shakl bir xil (A – A – A)

Bu fe'llarning deyarli hammasi `-t` yoki `-d` bilan tugaydi va qisqa, bir bo'g'inli. Zamonni shakl emas, gapning o'zi ko'rsatadi: vaqt so'zi (yesterday, every day) va 3-shaxsdagi `-s`. She **cuts** — hozirgi zamon (`-s` bor); She **cut** — o'tgan zamon (`-s` yo'q, garchi ega she bo'lsa ham).

items.text: Madina usually **puts** her keys in her bag.
Yesterday she **put** them on the table and forgot them.
items.translation: Kecha esa ularni stol ustiga **qo'ydi**-yu, unutib qoldirdi.

blocks.text: Eng katta va eng foydali guruh: V2 va V3 bir xil, demak har bir fe'l uchun faqat bitta yangi shakl yodlanadi. Ichida o'zgarishi bir xil bo'lgan kichik guruhlar bor — ularni birga, ohangiga qarab takrorlang.

items.text: We **bought** fruit at the market and **brought** it home.
items.translation: Bozordan meva **sotib oldik** va uyga **olib keldik**.

items.text: Have you **sent** the photos to Grandma?

blocks.text: **bought** va **brought** ni chalkashtirmang: b**r**ing → b**r**ought (olib kelmoq — `r` ikkalasida ham bor), buy → bought (sotib olmoq). **-ought / -aught** guruhini bitta gap qilib yodlang: «I **thought**, **bought**, **brought**, **caught**, **fought** and **taught**».
4-guruh: uchala shakl har xil (A – B – C)

Bu guruhda V2 va V3 farq qiladi, shuning uchun V3 ni V2 o'rniga ishlatish (I have **went**) eng ko'p uchraydigan xato. Yaxshi xabar: V3 larning ko'pi `-n` yoki `-en` bilan tugaydi (taken, written, known) — bu belgi ularni V2 dan ajratishga yordam beradi.

headers: V1 (V2 da o, V3 da o + n)

items.text: Dilnoza **wrote** three letters, but she **hasn't written** to her aunt yet.
items.translation: Dilnoza uchta xat **yozdi**, lekin xolasiga hali **yozmagan**.

items.text: Have you ever **swum** in a mountain lake?
The vase **was broken** before we arrived.

blocks.text: **i – a – u** guruhi uchun: alifbo tartibini eslang — **a** avval keladi (V2: s**a**ng, dr**a**nk), **u** keyin (V3: s**u**ng, dr**u**nk). V3 `-n` / `-en` bilan tugasa (taken, written, known), u yolg'iz kelmaydi — oldida doim have / has / had yoki be bo'ladi: «I **taken**» emas, I **have taken** yoki I **took**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have drank.» → I have **drunk**; «The film has began.» → has **begun**; «He has chose.» → has **chosen**; «I have came.» → I have **come**; «The bird flied.» → The bird **flew**; «I thinked.» → I **thought**; «It costed ten pounds.» → It **cost** ten pounds (1-guruhda `-ed` qo'shilmaydi).

rows: cut, put, let, hit, hurt, cost, shut, set, quit, read
bought, sent, kept, met, paid, sold, stood, made, found, won
come – came – come, run – ran – run
sang / sung, knew / known, broke / broken, ate / eaten, wrote / written
be – was / were – been, do – did – done, go – went – gone

examples.title: All three forms the same: **cut**, **put**, **let**
examples.description: 1-guruh: V1, V2 va V3 bir xil (cut, put, let, hit, hurt, cost, shut, set, quit, read). Zamonni vaqt so'zi va `-s` ning yo'qligi ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **cut** his finger while he was opening a tin.
sentences.translation: Bekzod konserva ochayotib barmog'ini **kesib oldi**.

sentences.text: Where **have** you **put** the scissors? I can't find them.
sentences.translation: Qaychini qayerga **qo'yding**? Topolmayapman.

sentences.text: My dad finally **let** me drive his car last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kuni dadam nihoyat mashinasini haydashimga **ruxsat berdi**.

sentences.text: The ball **hit** Emma on the head, but she was OK.
sentences.translation: To'p Emmaning boshiga **tegdi**, lekin u yaxshi edi.

sentences.text: Ouch! I **have hurt** my back carrying those heavy boxes.
sentences.translation: Voy! O'sha og'ir qutilarni ko'tarib, belimni **og'ritib oldim**.

sentences.text: The tickets to London **cost** us much more than we expected.
sentences.translation: London chiptalari bizga kutganimizdan ancha qimmatga **tushdi**.

sentences.text: Someone **shut** the door so loudly that the baby woke up.
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni shunchalik qattiq **yopdiki**, chaqaloq uyg'onib ketdi.

sentences.text: Before the guests came, we **set** the table in the garden.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin bog'da dasturxon **yozdik**.

sentences.text: My uncle **quit** smoking ten years ago and feels great now.
sentences.translation: Amakim o'n yil oldin chekishni **tashlagan** va hozir o'zini ajoyib his qiladi.

sentences.text: Last month I **read** four books in English — a personal record!
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy ingliz tilida to'rtta kitob **o'qidim** — shaxsiy rekord!

examples.title: **-ought** / **-aught**: bought, brought, taught
examples.description: V2 = V3, oxiri `-ought` yoki `-aught`: buy, bring, think, fight, catch, teach. bought (sotib oldi) va brought (olib keldi) ni farqlang.

sentences.text: Madina **bought** a new carpet for the living room.
sentences.translation: Madina mehmonxonaga yangi gilam **sotib oldi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **brought** us a plate of hot samsa.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz bizga bir tovoq issiq somsa **olib kelishdi**.

sentences.text: I **thought** about your idea all night.
sentences.translation: Tun bo'yi sizning fikringiz haqida **o'yladim**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **caught** a fish in this river?
sentences.translation: Hech bu daryodan baliq **tutganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Mrs Smith **has taught** English at our school for twenty years.
sentences.translation: Missis Smit maktabimizda yigirma yildan beri ingliz tilidan **dars beradi**.

sentences.text: The two boys **fought** over a football and both started crying.
sentences.translation: Ikki bola to'pni talashib **urishib qolishdi** va ikkalasi ham yig'lab yubordi.

sentences.text: James **caught** a cold after the football match in the rain.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yomg'irdagi futbol o'yinidan keyin **shamollab qoldi**.

sentences.text: Who **taught** your son to swim so well?
sentences.translation: O'g'lingizga shunday yaxshi suzishni kim **o'rgatgan**?

sentences.text: Everything we need **has been bought**, so we can start cooking.
sentences.translation: Kerakli hamma narsa **sotib olindi**, endi ovqat pishirishni boshlasak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Oh no, I **thought** you **brought** the cake!
sentences.translation: Voy, tortni sen **olib kelgansan**, deb **o'ylabman**!

examples.title: V2 = V3 with **-t**: sent, spent, kept, left
examples.description: V2 = V3, oxiri `-t`: send → sent, build → built (`-d` → `-t`); keep → kept, feel → felt, leave → left (uzun unli qisqaradi).

sentences.text: Dilnoza **sent** her CV to three companies last week.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'tgan hafta uchta kompaniyaga rezyumesini **jo'natdi**.

sentences.text: We **spent** the whole weekend at my grandparents' house in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Butun dam olish kunlarini Farg'onadagi bobom va buvimnikida **o'tkazdik**.

sentences.text: Tom **lent** me his car while mine was at the garage.
sentences.translation: Mening mashinam ustaxonada bo'lganida Tom menga mashinasini **berib turdi**.

sentences.text: This mosque **was built** in the sixteenth century.
sentences.translation: Bu masjid XVI asrda **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **kept** every letter my grandfather wrote to her.
sentences.translation: Buvim bobom yozgan har bir xatni **saqlab qo'ygan**.

sentences.text: The baby **slept** through the night for the first time!
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq birinchi marta tun bo'yi **uxladi**!

sentences.text: After the walk in the snow, Aziz **felt** cold and tired.
sentences.translation: Qorda sayr qilgandan keyin Aziz **sovqotdi** va charchadi.

sentences.text: Sarah **has left** her bag in the taxi again.
sentences.translation: Sara yana sumkasini taksida **qoldiribdi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **meant** Tuesday, not Thursday.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, payshanba emas, seshanbani **nazarda tutgandim**.

sentences.text: Our team **has lost** three games in a row, and the fans are angry.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz ketma-ket uchta o'yinda **yutqazdi**, muxlislar g'azabda.

examples.title: More V2 = V3: **paid**, **told**, **stood**, **found**
examples.description: V2 = V3 ning boshqa qoliplari: pay → paid, say → said; sell → sold, tell → told; stand → stood; hear → heard, hold → held, find → found, win → won, sit → sat.

sentences.text: Bekzod **paid** for everyone's lunch on his birthday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tug'ilgan kunida hammaning tushligi uchun **to'ladi**.

sentences.text: The doctor **said** I need to rest for a few days.
sentences.translation: Shifokor bir necha kun dam olishim kerakligini **aytdi**.

sentences.text: All the tickets for the concert **were sold** in two hours.
sentences.translation: Konsertning barcha chiptalari ikki soatda **sotilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Why **haven't** you **told** me about your new job?
sentences.translation: Nega menga yangi ishing haqida **aytmading**?

sentences.text: We **stood** at the bus stop for half an hour in the rain.
sentences.translation: Yomg'irda avtobus bekatida yarim soat **turdik**.

sentences.text: Emma **found** a wallet in the street and took it to the police.
sentences.translation: Emma ko'chada hamyon **topib oldi** va uni politsiyaga olib bordi.

sentences.text: The wedding **was held** in a big restaurant in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: To'y Samarqanddagi katta restoranda **o'tkazildi**.

sentences.text: I **have** never **heard** such a beautiful voice.
sentences.translation: Bunday chiroyli ovozni hech qachon **eshitmaganman**.

sentences.text: Our class **won** the school quiz, and the teacher **made** a cake for us.
sentences.translation: Sinfimiz maktab viktorinasida **g'olib bo'ldi**, o'qituvchi esa bizga tort **pishirdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **sat** next to a woman she **had met** on holiday in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madina Buxorodagi ta'tilda **tanishgan** ayolning yoniga **o'tirdi**.

examples.title: **i – a – u**: began / begun, sang / sung
examples.description: 4-guruhning i – a – u qolipi (begin, drink, ring, sing, sink, swim) va V3 = V1 bo'lgan come, run: V2 da `a`, V3 da `u`.

sentences.text: The lesson **began** at nine, but Aziz arrived at ten.
sentences.translation: Dars soat to'qqizda **boshlandi**, Aziz esa o'nda keldi.

sentences.text: By the time we got there, the film **had** already **begun**.
sentences.translation: Biz yetib borganimizda film allaqachon **boshlangan edi**.

sentences.text: Grandma **sang** old Uzbek songs to us when we were little.
sentences.translation: Kichkinaligimizda buvim bizga eski o'zbek qo'shiqlarini **kuylab berardi**.

sentences.text: This song **has been sung** by many famous singers.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiqni ko'plab mashhur xonandalar **kuylagan**.

sentences.text: Who **drank** all the milk? The fridge is empty!
sentences.translation: Hamma sutni kim **ichib qo'ydi**? Muzlatgich bo'm-bo'sh!

sentences.text: Have you ever **swum** in the sea at night?
sentences.translation: Hech kechasi dengizda **suzganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Somebody **rang** the doorbell, but when I opened the door, nobody was there.
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshik qo'ng'irog'ini **chaldi**, lekin ochganimda hech kim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: Emma **has run** three marathons this year.
sentences.translation: Emma bu yil uchta marafon **yugurdi**.

sentences.text: Spring **has come** early this year, and the trees are already green.
sentences.translation: Bu yil bahor erta **keldi**, daraxtlar allaqachon ko'karib qoldi.

sentences.text: The ship **sank** in a storm, but all the sailors were saved.
sentences.translation: Kema bo'ronda **cho'kib ketdi**, lekin barcha dengizchilar qutqarildi.

examples.title: V3 with **-n** / **-en**: eaten, given, written
examples.description: 4-guruh: V3 `-n` yoki `-en` bilan tugaydi (eaten, given, taken, seen, written, driven, fallen, ridden, hidden, bitten) — oldida doim have / has / had yoki be.

sentences.text: **Have** you **eaten** Bukhara plov? It's different from Tashkent plov.
sentences.translation: Buxoro palovini **yeganmisiz**? U Toshkent palovidan farq qiladi.

sentences.text: My parents **have given** me a laptop for my birthday.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam tug'ilgan kunimga noutbuk **sovg'a qilishdi**.

sentences.text: The photo **was taken** at the top of the mountain.
sentences.translation: Surat tog' cho'qqisida **olingan**.

sentences.text: I **haven't seen** Bekzod since he moved to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Oksfordga ko'chib ketganidan beri uni **ko'rmadim**.

sentences.text: James **has written** a book about his travels in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Markaziy Osiyo bo'ylab sayohatlari haqida kitob **yozdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has** never **driven** on the right side of the road.
sentences.translation: Sara hech qachon yo'lning o'ng tomonidan mashina **haydamagan**.

sentences.text: Several trees **had fallen** across the road after the storm.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin yo'lga bir nechta daraxt **qulab tushgan edi**.

sentences.text: My little sister **has** never **ridden** a horse.
sentences.translation: Singlim hech qachon ot **minmagan**.

sentences.text: The children **had hidden** the presents under the bed.
sentences.translation: Bolalar sovg'alarni karavot ostiga **yashirib qo'yishgan edi**.

sentences.text: A boy **was bitten** by a snake near the river, but he's fine now.
sentences.translation: Daryo yaqinida bir bolani ilon **chaqib oldi**, lekin hozir u yaxshi.

examples.title: **knew / known**, **broke / broken**
examples.description: 4-guruhning ikki qolipi: `-ew` → `-own` (know, grow, fly, throw) va V2 da `o`, V3 da `o` + `n` (break, speak, choose, steal, wake, wear).

sentences.text: Everyone **knew** about the party except me!
sentences.translation: Ziyofat haqida mendan boshqa hamma **bilardi**!

sentences.text: Our son **has grown** so much this year.
sentences.translation: O'g'limiz bu yil juda **o'sib ketdi**.

sentences.text: We **flew** from Tashkent to London in six hours.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Londonga olti soatda **uchib bordik**.

sentences.text: The players **threw** their coach into the air after the victory.
sentences.translation: G'alabadan keyin o'yinchilar murabbiyini havoga **otishdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has broken** his leg skiing in Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Aziz Chimyonda chang'i uchayotib oyog'ini **sindirib oldi**.

sentences.text: **Has** anyone **spoken** to the manager about the problem?
sentences.translation: Muammo haqida kimdir menejer bilan **gaplashdimi**?

sentences.text: Madina **was chosen** as the best student of the year.
sentences.translation: Madina yilning eng yaxshi talabasi deb **tanlandi**.

sentences.text: Two paintings **were stolen** from the gallery during the night.
sentences.translation: Tunda galereyadan ikkita rasm **o'g'irlandi**.

sentences.text: I **woke** up at five because of the noise outside.
sentences.translation: Tashqaridagi shovqin tufayli soat beshda **uyg'onib ketdim**.

sentences.text: These jeans **are** completely **worn** out — I need a new pair.
sentences.translation: Bu jinsi shim butunlay **eskirib ketibdi** — yangisi kerak.

examples.title: Mixed: V2 or V3? **saw** / **have seen**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bir gapda V2 (Past Simple) va V3 (have / had / be + V3) yonma-yon. be, do, go kabi alohida fe'llar ham.

sentences.text: I **saw** Emma yesterday, but I **haven't seen** her brother for ages.
sentences.translation: Kecha Emmani **ko'rdim**, lekin akasini ancha vaqtdan beri **ko'rmadim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **went** to Samarkand last year, and now he **has gone** there again.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'tgan yili Samarqandga **borgan edi**, endi yana u yerga **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **did** the shopping, and I **have done** the cooking.
sentences.translation: Xaridni Dilnoza **qildi**, ovqatni esa men **pishirib bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: We **were** in London in May, but we **have** never **been** to Scotland.
sentences.translation: May oyida Londonda **bo'ldik**, lekin Shotlandiyada hech qachon **bo'lmaganmiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah **wrote** the email an hour ago, but she **hasn't sent** it yet.
sentences.translation: Sara xatni bir soat oldin **yozdi**, lekin hali **jo'natmadi**.

sentences.text: The cat **ate** its food and then **lay** down by the stove.
sentences.translation: Mushuk ovqatini **yedi**, keyin pechka yoniga **yotib oldi**.

sentences.text: My brother **took** my phone this morning and **hasn't given** it back.
sentences.translation: Akam bugun ertalab telefonimni **olib qo'ydi** va hali **qaytarib bermadi**.

sentences.text: It **froze** hard last night, so the roads **are frozen** this morning.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi qattiq **sovuq tushdi**, shuning uchun bugun ertalab yo'llar **muzlab qolgan**.

sentences.text: The children **drew** pictures, which **were hung** on the classroom wall.
sentences.translation: Bolalar rasmlar **chizishdi**, ular sinf devoriga **ilib qo'yildi**.

sentences.text: When Aziz **came** home, his friends **had** already **left**.
sentences.translation: Aziz uyga **kelganda**, do'stlari allaqachon **ketib qolgan edi**.
